header.name: [bedrock-research]entity-matchmaking-figures-rp_v1.0.1
header.description: v1.0.1 - Lobby screen added to the vanilla chest panel and picked by the container title. Lobby members are drawn by live_horse_renderer from quoted entity ids in slot names, and bot entities are shown only in the UI through q.is_in_ui. Vanilla chest parts are hidden only by bindings inserted with modifications that read the shared entity_ui_hide_vanilla marker.
